name: Waverly
install: export BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun"; export PATH="$BUN_INSTALL/bin:$PATH"; command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1 || curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash -s "bun-v1.3.10"; export PATH="$BUN_INSTALL/bin:$PATH"; bun install
start: export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; bunx --bun portless proxy start; bunx --bun portless trust

terminals.name: website
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; ASTRO_DEV_BACKGROUND=1 bun run --cwd apps/website dev

terminals.name: docs
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; ASTRO_DEV_BACKGROUND=1 bun run --cwd apps/docs dev
